# Sony portrait detail originals

These two distinct Sony ZV-1A ARW photographs are unmodified full camera originals
copied from the user-provided exFAT SD card **42C1-6450**, under
`DCIM/100MSDCF`, on **2026-10-29**. Their combined size is **41,965,568 bytes**.
The source card and its originals were not changed.

On 2026-10-29 the user explicitly requested that every photograph used for project
testing or benchmarks be stored in the project's GitHub repository. This authorizes
repository inclusion and repeatable Irodori project testing for these selected
originals. **This is not a CC0 grant or another general open-content license.**
The photographs retain their original rights; this notice does not authorize
unrelated reuse or apply Apache-2.0 to their image content.

[manifest.json](manifest.json) records source-relative paths, original SHA-256 and
byte counts, the selection indices, selected numeric EXIF, metadata-tool version,
orientation and the verification scope. Both card originals and copied files
matched their expected hashes before and after copying. No photograph was resized,
repeated, metadata-stripped or rewritten.

| Original       | Recorded capture                                 | Intended coverage                                                                                                       |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `DSC03315.ARW` | ISO 400, 1/250 s, f/4, 25.7 mm; Orientation 1    | Outdoor face and long hair, knitted hat/fleece texture, fine foreground leaves and soft background.                     |
| `DSC03408.ARW` | ISO 6400, 1/100 s, f/2.8, 25.7 mm; Orientation 1 | Indoor face and dark hair under warm lighting, a smooth wall, a finely patterned backdrop and bright decorative lights. |

ExifTool reports 5504 × 3672 storage dimensions for both originals. These metadata
dimensions are provisional. The application must obtain actual decoded, oriented,
lens-corrected native dimensions before choosing proof regions. Neither a camera
JPEG nor its metadata dimensions establish the native RAW frame.

The embedded 1616 × 1080 JPEGs were inspected only to select relevant photographic
content. They are not included as alternate native sources, and they cannot provide
RAW detail or processing acceptance. These fixtures are not a controlled clean/noisy
pair, a radiometric reference or a calibrated automatic noise model. ISO values are
recorded capture facts. Portrait quality, CPU/GPU agreement, resources, performance,
native input and export behavior need their separate checks. No real starfield is
provided by this set.

The files are test inputs only. They must never be loaded as demonstration photos
or imported into a user's library automatically. Keep generated crops, profiles,
screenshots, results and private inventory evidence outside Git.
